findings.passage: Returning voters: You  DO NOT  have to show any identification at the polls. The only person(s) that shall show photo/non-photo identification are first-time voters.
findings.note: From the voter FAQ page on her official Senate site (page first published 2024-10-15, last modified 2026-08-12, so the wording may have changed). It describes current state rules on ID at the polls for returning and first-time voters. It is explanatory, not a call for change.

findings.passage: The legislature has initiated the process to amend the Pennsylvania Constitution.
findings.note: Closing sentence of the FAQ paragraph on stricter 'Voter ID' laws in other states and the 2012 Pennsylvania photo ID law that a court struck down. Same page and date caveat as above. The page itself says the amendment process has begun, without saying what the amendment would require.
